obsidian-canvas.$description: Obsidian Canvas — Page background, deepest surface

onyx-card.$description: Onyx Card — Card fills, elevated surfaces above the canvas

graphite-layer.$description: Graphite Layer — Input backgrounds, subtle surface lift from Obsidian

slate-border.$description: Slate Border — Primary 1px hairline borders on cards, inputs, containers

iron-border.$description: Iron Border — Stronger border weight for emphasis on key containers

ash-mute.$description: Ash Mute — Muted body text, secondary labels, placeholder text, weak borders

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Primary text, primary CTA outline stroke, high-contrast borders on dark canvas

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Outlined link/mention border and text — the only chromatic functional accent in the system

prism-gradient.$description: Prism Gradient — Brand gradient — lime through amber to magenta, applied to logo, wordmark, and hero brand moments

inter.$description: Single-family system. Weight 400 for body, labels, and buttons; weight 500 reserved for headings, emphasized labels, and nav. Negative tracking tightened with size: -0.033em at 8–12px caption scale, -0.030em at 14–18px body, -0.025em at 24–42px display. This monotone weight palette (only 400 and 500 exist) is a signature choice — the interface whispers hierarchy through size and tracking, not through bold/regular contrast.
